text: Jordan pushed through a rough patch by dragging themselves through a full workday at Marcus's office, despite their mind drifting toward a new idea for Coda—quick-start cards that remember tempo and practiced pieces. After apologizing to Mika for bailing the night before, Jordan spent two hours at Groundwork building the feature, then came home to cook a real meal and enjoy some calm time with Pepper. They end the entry recognizing their recurring cycle—shutdown, isolation, then creation at Groundwork restoring them—and wish they could skip the isolating middle stretch.
